About the role:

Samsara's Product Operations team is looking for a hands-on builder to join our Platform team and help accelerate our enterprise-ready roadmap. You will support the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams, working closely with R&D leaders to turn ambiguous questions into rigorous analyses, repeatable workflows, and internal tools used across our Product and Engineering organization.

You move ARR. Not "contribute to." Revenue (or an equivalent business result) grows because of decisions you made. You might investigate why enterprise customers stall on a security or permissions requirement, combine signals from thousands of support tickets and customer conversations to find what's blocking expansion, or build a dashboard that helps hundreds of product managers and engineers see how platform gaps translate into pipeline and retention risk.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone who has already shown they can build and ship. You do not need a technical background. However, you do need to use modern AI and development tools to move beyond a prototype: work with data, write and debug code using AI, validate the results, put a useful tool in front of users, and improve it until people trust and rely on it.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and, most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set you up for success and have built a culture of rapid career development, with countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: Our vision to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that encourages you to do your best.
  • You measure yourself by revenue outcomes: You want your work tied directly to ARR, and you're accountable for the result, not just the activity.

In this role, you will: 

  • Drive ARR through platform decisions.Identify the enterprise-readiness gaps that most limit new business, expansion, and retention, and shape prioritization so that fixing them measurably moves ARR.
  • Accelerate enterprise-ready deliveryby partnering with the Billing, Org & Auth, and Security product teams to define priorities, remove blockers, and track progress against the commitments customers and Sales are waiting on.
  • Build and ship internal data and AI products that help Product and Engineering teams understand platform usage, customer friction, and the highest-impact opportunities to improve.
  • Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including product telemetry, support tickets, customer conversations, feature requests, surveys, and product metadata, to find patterns that would be difficult to see manually.
  • Turn one-time analyses into reliable, repeatable tools and workflows with clear data definitions, quality checks, documentation, and feedback loops.
  • Translate complex findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for R&D leadership, while preserving the evidence and methodology behind them.
  • Quantify the revenue impact of platform investments and report on it, so every roadmap bet has a clear, defensible ARR case before and after launch.
  • Own projects end to end: scope the problem, identify and connect the right data, build the first version, launch it, measure adoption and business impact, and continue improving it.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully, checking outputs, debugging failures, and applying sound judgment rather than treating generated work as automatically correct.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in a role such as product operations, data or product analytics, business operations, consulting, technical product management, or another environment where you solved ambiguous problems with data and technology.
  • A demonstrated record of building and shipping something useful for real users, such as an internal tool, application, dashboard, automation, data product, or repeatable analytical workflow.
  • A track record of connecting your work to revenue or an equivalent business result (ARR, retention, expansion, cost), and the ability to show how your decisions caused it.
  • Experience structuring and analyzing messy or large datasets, validating the results, and explaining what the analysis does and does not prove.
  • Strong product and customer judgment: you start with the user problem and business outcome, not the technology.
  • Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain technical or analytical work to non-technical partners and executives without losing the important details.
  • High ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking sharp questions, forming a point of view, and iterating through ambiguity.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience in a B2B technology company or working closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Experience in Product Operations functions: defining and tracking product roadmaps and feature requests, and bringing the voice of the customer to every product conversation.
  • Familiarity with enterprise platform domains such as billing and monetization, identity, access, and org management, or security and compliance, and with what enterprise buyers require in each.

This role complements the Engagement Services Manager (ESM) and SIS teams. It ensures every integration request reaches SIS with validated requirements, aligned stakeholders, and documented processes. This role can be office-based or fully remote.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Run structured discovery with customer stakeholders to document current-state processes and systems.

  • Build a systems and API inventory covering data volumes, authentication constraints, and regulatory or data-residency considerations.
  • Engage SIS early for lightweight feasibility checks so blockers surface before build.
  1. Package requirements (weeks 6–10)
  • Turn findings into a prioritized requirements package: use cases, field-level data mappings, success criteria, and open risks.
  • Validate the package with customer stakeholders and the internal account team (CSM, ESM, Sales Engineer).
  • Complete and submit the SIS Request Log so scoping starts from a validated baseline.
  1. Hand off and transition (weeks 10–12)
  • Join the initial SIS/ESM scoping meeting to preserve context and answer requirements questions directly.
  • Support the ESM during SOW drafting where scope or customer intent needs clarification.
  • Formally close the discovery engagement once SIS and the ESM confirm the request is ready for build, with documentation handed off in full.

Ongoing

  • Track engagement status, milestones, and timelines in Salesforce and Compass.
  • Maintain a library of discovery templates and playbooks by integration type, and share lessons learned with the teams that originate requests.
  • Champion Samsara's cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team.

  • Speed - Short time from kickoff to a request SIS accepts without further scoping clarification
  • Quality - Requests that need no rework during SIS and ESM scoping.
  • Cycle time - Faster path from Request Log to signed SOW compared with baseline.
  • Customer experience - Strong discovery-phase CSAT and feedback from Enterprise stakeholders.
  • Portfolio impact - More Enterprise accounts moving from an unscoped integration need to a signed, in-build SIS project each quarter.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 7+ years in a customer-facing consulting, business/systems analysis, solutions consulting, or implementation role, ideally in enterprise SaaS or IoT software.
  • Experience running structured discovery with enterprise customers: stakeholder interviews, current- vs. future-state process mapping, and requirements gathering.
  • Working understanding of APIs and system-integration concepts; comfortable in technical conversations without needing to write integration code.
  • Strong facilitation, synthesis, and documentation skills, with the ability to turn cross-functional conversations into an actionable requirements document.
  • Track record managing multi-month, multi-stakeholder engagements independently, with ownership of timeline and quality.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with integrations involving fleet/telematics, ERP, WMS, TMS/dispatch, HRIS, or fuel-card systems.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and services/project-tracking tools.
  • Background as a Solutions Consultant, Sales/Solutions Engineer, Professional Services consultant, or Business/Systems Analyst.
  • Experience supporting Mexico and broader LatAm Enterprise accounts.

  • Complete SIS Office Hours and Request Log training, and review prior SIS project documentation for common integration patterns.

descriptionHtml:

Über die Position

Als Account Development Representative (ADR) bei Samsara wirst du sowohl im Job als auch durch unser Trainingsprogramm, das von erstklassigen Vertriebsprofis geleitet wird, auf deine nächste Rolle als Account Executive vorbereitet.

Dein Tagesgeschäft: Du baust Pipelines für unser DACH-Geschäft auf und generierst durch proaktive Outbound-Ansprache neue Opportunities.

Wir haben Büros in London, Paris und Amsterdam und bieten Remote-Arbeit aus Deutschland, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und dem Vereinigten Königreich an.

Dies ist eine Remote-Position für Kandidat:innen mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Frankreich, den Niederlanden oder im Vereinigten Königreich. Für die Position gelten Arbeitszeiten in MEZ (CET). Für diese Rolle wird keine Umzugsunterstützung angeboten.

Der Job passt zu dir, wenn …

  • … du die Branchen mitgestalten willst, die unsere Welt am Laufen halten: Deine Arbeit hat realen Einfluss. Du hilfst dabei, dass die Lichter anbleiben, Lebensmittel in die Supermärkte kommen und, vor allem, dass Arbeiter:innen sicher nach Hause zurückkehren.
  • … du Architekt:in deiner eigenen Karriere bist: Wenn du dich reinhängst, wird diese Rolle nicht deine letzte bei Samsara sein. Erfolgreiche ADRs können innerhalb von zwei Jahren oder weniger in eine Full Sales Cycle-Position aufsteigen.
  • … du gerne mit Menschen sprichst: In dieser Rolle führst du durchschnittlich über 60 Anrufe pro Tag mit potenziellen Kund:innen.
  • … du von Natur aus neugierig bist, wie Unternehmen funktionieren: An einem Tag sprichst du mit jemandem aus der Abfallwirtschaft, am nächsten lernst du das Innenleben eines Lebensmittel-Distributionszentrums kennen. Unsere besten Vertriebsmitarbeitenden wollen die Abläufe der Unternehmen, die sie betreuen, bis ins Detail verstehen, um mehr zu bewirken.
  • … du Ablehnung als Lernchance verstehst: In dieser Rolle wird auch mal aufgelegt, und du wirst Absagen bekommen. Du brauchst die Resilienz, immer wieder zum Hörer zu greifen, um Samsaras Mission zu verkaufen.
  • … du mit den Besten arbeiten willst: Samsaras leistungsorientierte Vertriebskultur bedeutet, dass du von den Besten umgeben bist und herausgefordert wirst, weiterzugehen als je zuvor.

In dieser Position wirst du:

  • Pipeline aufbauen durch personalisierte Ansprache von Interessent:innen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn
  • die Möglichkeit haben, an Messen und Events teilzunehmen, um die Marke Samsara zu repräsentieren und mit potenziellen Kund:innen und Partnern in Kontakt zu treten
  • zur Produktexpertin bzw. zum Produktexperten werden und die Samsara-Art des Verkaufens lernen
  • sorgfältig alle Interaktionen mit Accounts in unserem CRM (Salesforce.com) dokumentieren
  • die Kulturprinzipien von Samsara (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) vertreten, vorleben und verankern, während wir global und mit neuen Standorten weiter wachsen

Mindestanforderungen für die Position:

  • 1–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in kundennahen Positionen
  • Mindestens 6–12 Monate Vertriebserfahrung
  • Hohe Motivation und Engagement sowie der ausgeprägte Wunsch, in einem zielorientierten Vertrieb zu arbeiten
  • Nachweisliche Erfolgsbilanz darin, die Ziele bzw. Erwartungen in früheren Rollen konstant zu übertreffen
  • Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mündlich und schriftlich
  • Neugier und die Fähigkeit, aufschlussreiche Fragen zu stellen
  • Überzeugte:r Verfechter:in eines Growth Mindsets
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse und fließende Deutschkenntnisse

Idealerweise bringst du außerdem mit:

  • Erfahrung in Closing-Rollen im Vertrieb
  • Nachweisliche Erfolge über den Beruf hinaus (z. B. in Studium, Sport, ehrenamtlichem Engagement, …)
  • Bereitschaft, in einem „Win as a Team"-Umfeld zusammenzuarbeiten und andere zu beeinflussen
  • Begeisterung dafür, neue Probleme auf innovative Weise zu lösen
  • Motivation, ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im IoT- und SaaS-Bereich mitaufzubauen

ADR-Karrierepfade

Im ADR-Programm von Samsara gibt es stets Möglichkeiten, die nächste Stufe zu erreichen und mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sowohl während des Programms als auch darüber hinaus. Wer hart arbeitet und sich schnell weiterentwickelt, kann seine Karriere vorantreiben. Mit dem Schwerpunkt auf kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung endet das Training nicht nach dem Onboarding: Wir bieten ADRs die Möglichkeit, ihr Verständnis für den Markt und unsere Wettbewerber zu vertiefen, die im Vertrieb notwendigen Skills auszubauen und gemeinsam mit Mentor:innen die drei Stufen unseres ADR-Programms zu durchlaufen.

  • ADR I: Die ADRs konzentrieren sich auf Inbound-Leads. Sie führen eine hohe Anzahl an Gesprächen, erklären die Produkte im Detail und bauen Beziehungen zu Interessent:innen auf, die sich für Samsara interessieren. Auf der Stufe ADR I bieten wir zahlreiche Lernmöglichkeiten, darunter Call-Sessions mit erfahreneren Mitgliedern des Sales-Teams sowie Schulungen zu Tools (Salesforce, Salesloft, Lusha), Produktwissen, Einwandbehandlung und mehr. Unsere ADRs auf dieser Stufe sind Macher:innen, die ihre Karriere durch die für sie geschaffenen Möglichkeiten vorantreiben können.
  • ADR II: Die nächste Stufe im Programm. Hier arbeiten unsere ADRs am oberen Ende des Funnels, schaffen hochwertige Sales-Engagements und unterstützen unsere Account Executives. Mit dem Schritt in die Outbound-Arbeit kommen die ADRs auf Stufe II kontinuierlich mit neuen Lernmöglichkeiten in Berührung und nehmen an Spezialtrainings teil, u. a. zu professionellem Schreiben, personabasierter Ansprache, Cold Calling 2.0 sowie Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikation mit Account Executives. Nachdem sie ihre Outbound-Fähigkeiten aufgebaut und Sales-Zertifizierungen erworben haben, steigen unsere ADRs in die letzte Stufe des Programms auf.
  • ADR III: Die höchste Stufe in unserer Organisation. Diese ADRs arbeiten Hand in Hand mit den Field Account Executives und Enterprise Regional Sales Managern bei Samsara. Sie betreuen gemeinsam große Accounts, setzen detaillierte Gebietspläne um, nehmen an wöchentlichen Strategiemeetings teil und planen Kunden-Demos bzw. nehmen daran teil. Außerdem nehmen ADR IIIs an einem Mentoring-Programm teil, in dem sie von Führungskräften des Account-Executive-Teams lernen, die ihnen Einblicke und Training ermöglichen, bevor sie sich im Interview für eine Account-Executive-Position beweisen.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own end-to-end P2P performance, from requisition and PO through receipt, invoice, approval, payment, and accrual, and align every tower (Procurement, AP, Supplier Management, Payments, Close) to one operating model

  • Partner with suppliers, Procurement, Finance, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders to define and deliver the automation and transformation roadmap

  • Oversee supplier risk, contract and PO compliance, and spend visibility across the vendor base
  • Manage change by rolling out policy, process, and system updates with clear stakeholder communication and adoption tracking
  • Elevate customer satisfaction across internal stakeholders and suppliers by owning the service experience, measuring CSAT/NPS, and acting on feedback
  • Deliver quarterly business reviews with senior and executive stakeholders, presenting performance, risks, and the improvement roadmap
  • Hire, develop, and coach a high-performing team, and hold every team member to a consistent standard through documented processes, training, performance calibration, and clear accountability

  • Track record of running operational governance: SLAs, KPIs, internal controls, and audit/SOX compliance
  • Experience owning a team budget, managing vendor relationships, and managing remote, cross-time-zone teams
  • Experience developing and presenting executive-level QBRs and improving stakeholder satisfaction
  • Proven ability to develop, train, and calibrate teams to a uniform standard
  • ERP experience (NetSuite preferred) plus a P2P platform such as Zip, Coupa, or Ariba
  • Bachelor’s in accounting, finance, business, or supply chain
  • Preferred: APM, CPSM, CPA, or equivalent

  • The ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions
  • A history of being a collaborator, strategic thinker, and influencer

About the role

Maps are part of nearly everything Samsara builds. Vehicles, routes, sites, assets, and safety workflows all depend on knowing where things are and how the physical world fits together. The Maps team is building the shared geospatial platform that makes that possible.

We source, ingest, enrich, and serve the map data that Samsara's product teams use every day: from road networks and points of interest to addresses, boundaries, and customer-specific map context. Our customers are the engineers building products for millions of workers and the businesses that depend on them. When our data and APIs are accurate, reliable, and easy to use, every team building location-aware experiences at Samsara moves faster.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help set the technical direction for this platform. You'll work across the geospatial stack: building data ingestion and processing pipelines, modeling and serving map data, improving map matching and routing foundations, and creating APIs that make spatial capabilities reusable across Samsara. It's a small team with broad ownership, and the systems you build will become foundational infrastructure for teams across the company.

This role is remote and open to candidates based in the US.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You enjoy working with internal and external customers to iterate and build software platforms
  • You care about what Samsara does. The software we build helps keep grocery shelves stocked, lights on, and workers safe on the job.
  • You work with urgency and think through the best solutions for the opportunities, requirements, and scale in front of you.
  • You work well with others. We move faster when we move together.

In this role, you'll:

  • Shape the technical direction of the Maps teams
  • Build geospatial systems and integrations that support foundational features across most Samsara products.
  • Scale our offerings to continue to support storage, query and computational load of the real-time features dependent on them
  • Consolidate existing team-specific geospatial solutions into scalable platform-wide offerings.
  • Build agentic solutions that allow our customers to self-serve the data they want to see how they want to see it.
  • Raise the technical bar through code reviews, design discussions, and mentorship
  • Partner with engineering leadership on the bets worth making, and be honest about tradeoffs
  • Represent Samsara externally when it makes sense — talks, open source, community engagement with the mapping/geospatial ecosystem
  • Live out our cultural principles: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team

Minimum requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years building software, with at least 2 years in an architect or technical leadership role
  • Strong programming and design fundamentals
  • 4+ years working on large-scale distributed systems
  • 4+ years leading technical projects across multiple teams

Nice to have:

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial analysis, including PostGIS, spatial SQL, GeoPandas/Shapely, QGIS, and geospatial data validation
  • Familiarity with geospatial data formats and open mapping ecosystems, including GeoParquet, OpenStreetMap (OSM), and OSM PBF; experience ingesting, transforming, validating, or serving these datasets
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and getting teams aligned without needing formal authority

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross-functional automation.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

  • Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
  • Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
  • Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
  • Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. 
  • Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
  • Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
  • Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem. 
  • Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
  • Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
  • Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
  • Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will:

  • Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
  • Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
  • Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
  • Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts. 
  • Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
  • Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
  • Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem. 
  • Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
  • Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
  • Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
  • Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis

title: Contract and Billing Specialist
descriptionHtml:

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's Customer Success team is on the front lines of business value delivery by helping customers adopt our platform, realize measurable business value, and renew and expand with confidence. Billing errors, concession requests, and cancellation or return exceptions currently land with CSMs, CS managers, and several partner teams, each holding part of the picture. As our customer base and billing complexity have grown, these cases take too long, repeat for the same reasons, and pull CSMs away from adoption and renewal work. As the Contract and Billing Resolution Specialist, you will be the single owner of complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts.

You will take a customer's report that something is wrong with their bill, work out what happened across systems and teams, choose the right path to fix it, and see it through, keeping the customer informed. It is part detective, part project manager, part customer advocate. You will also tell the teams who own the underlying systems and processes what keeps breaking.

Your role will be cross-functional, working alongside and connecting Customer Success Managers, Sales, Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal. This is a new role, and you will help shape the case record, the root-cause tags, and the monthly read-out that define how Customer Success resolves billing and contract cases at Samsara.

This is a remote  position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Own complex billing and contract cases for Mid-Market and Commercial accounts, from the first report to a confirmed fix, and keep the customer informed in plain terms, including accounts that are delinquent or facing suspension.
  • Reconstruct the full story behind a billing error across contracts, order forms, segment or ownership changes, reprocessing, and invoicing, including cases with several AE handoffs and no clean record of what was promised.
  • Separate a correction of a Samsara error from a concession, a return, a reprocess, and a contract amendment, and choose the path that fixes the customer's billing, not only the immediate complaint.
  • Drive Billing Support, Order-to-Cash, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to execute the fix.
  • Evaluate and prepare concession requests: confirm whether Samsara was at fault, size the request against policy and the approval matrix, write a short case summary (what happened, root cause, options considered and ruled out, recommendation, and risk), route it to the right approver, and confirm the credit is applied and the customer told.
  • Support cancellation, return, and ETF exceptions: validate eligibility (purchase and renewal dates, trial history, Return ACV, financing partner, documentation), prepare the case for the approving team, act as the Customer Success fallback when the first approver does not respond within the window, and make sure approved outcomes are processed.
  • Be the front door for billing, concession, and cancellation requests: log every request in a single case record, including those that arrive via Slack, email, or Gainsight; redirect them to the right path; and coach CSMs and AEs on what a complete request looks like.
  • Fix repeat causes: tag the root cause on every case, separate one-offs from systemic failures, and deliver a monthly read-out to the teams that own the systems and processes involved.
  • Carry forward the billing improvement work with Support, Finance, and Product, including earlier detection of billing problems that threaten renewals.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's operating principles, including Keep a High Bar, Be Intellectually Honest, and Solve Problems Together, as we scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 4+ years of experience in billing operations, order to cash, revenue operations, deal desk, contracts, or a similar finance and operations role.
  • This is a demanding position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence.
  • Strong investigative skills: you can rebuild a timeline from incomplete or conflicting information across CRM, billing, and contract systems, including when the people involved have left.
  • Sound financial judgment about credits, concessions, reprocessing, and refunds, and a clear way of explaining your recommendation.
  • Customer-facing communication that stays honest and composed in hard conversations, and written summaries a leader can read once and decide on.
  • A record of driving results across teams without authority over them, including working to deadlines in an approval process.
  • Familiarity with order forms, amendments, and terms, and how they flow into billing.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and incomplete precedent, and rigorous case management so nothing drops across weeks and stakeholders.
  • Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience handling escalated or high-dollar billing disputes.
  • Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or an equivalent ERP, and CPQ tools. We also use Zendesk, Gainsight, and Sweethawk.
  • Customer Success, Support, or account management background with customer-facing financial or contract work.
  • Experience building or improving billing dispute processes.
  • Exposure to subscription or hardware-plus-subscription billing.
  • AI First: Experience using AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Strong bias for action and insistence on high standards

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Are you an exceptionally agile, strategic, and execution-focused Executive Assistant ready to power high-growth leadership? In this high-impact, dynamic role, you will serve as the strategic operational backbone and trusted partner to 3 Area Vice Presidents across our fast-paced Sales organization. You will master intricate calendaring, architect complex travel itineraries, oversee expense management, and drive high-profile team events. If you are a proactive, self-directed problem solver who thrives under pressure and knows how to seamlessly balance day-to-day priorities with big-picture objectives, this position offers an incredible platform to make a direct impact.

This is a remote position based in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 

In this role, you will: 

  • Serve as an Executive Ambassador: Represent your 3 Area VPs with polish and diplomacy across key external partners, high-profile clients, and internal department stakeholders.
  • Drive Calendar Strategy: Proactively optimize, align, and defend complex schedules across multiple Sales leaders to maximize business momentum and executive focus.
  • Master Logistics & Travel: Design and book multi-leg travel itineraries, anticipating seamlessly for potential schedule changes and travel logistics.
  • Manage Business Expenses: Oversee, track, and streamline expense reporting and reconciliations with high accuracy.
  • Orchestrate Staff Meetings: Partner with leadership to curate agendas, prepare materials, and track key deliverables for departmental meetings.
  • Lead Event Planning: Plan, coordinate, and execute impactful team offsites, strategy summits, and team-building events that drive culture and connection.
  • Anticipate & Resolve: Stay ten steps ahead by anticipating executive needs, eliminating friction, and tackling shifting business priorities with urgency.
  • Execute Strategic Projects: Own ad-hoc administrative initiatives and operational projects to increase overall leadership efficiency.
  • Champion Culture: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of executive administrative experience directly supporting executives in a fast-paced corporate environment.
  • Proven track record of managing complex, multi-executive calendars, travel logistics, and shifting priorities with exceptional accuracy and composure.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, with high emotional intelligence and executive presence across all internal and external touchpoints.
  • Demonstrated discretion and sound judgment when handling highly sensitive company information and business scenarios.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Prior experience supporting high-growth Sales leadership within a SaaS or enterprise technology company.
  • Proficiency with AI productivity tools and modern enterprise workflow technology to enhance administrative efficiency.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary$82,025—$106,150 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

descriptionHtml:

As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:Samsara’s cloud-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery-powered, wireless sensors, Linux-based IoT gateways, and Internet-connected dashcams. These devices are the building blocks Samsara uses to construct enterprise solutions for a wide range of verticals, including commercial fleet management and industrial monitoring. Through a unique integration of sensor data such as GPS, acceleration, temperature, video, and more, we enable our customers to gain greater insights into operations, identify and eliminate inefficiencies, and react to alerts all in near real-time.

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Samsara, you will develop software that runs on millions of devices, deployed by our industrial and enterprise customers. You’ll tackle challenges including evaluating and selecting hardware components, bringing up new hardware platforms and sensors, building systems to gather data and detect meaningful events, and structuring recorded data to allow efficient analysis across thousands of devices while providing deep insights into individual events.

We use C for our MCU-based platforms, Golang for embedded applications on Linux-based gateways and backend services, Google protocol buffers to structure data, and various AWS technologies to process and store data. Experience with these exact technologies is not required.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. 

Click hereto learn more about Samsara's cultural philosophy. 

In this role, you will:

  • Shape the hardware, not just the code that runs on it. Sit in reviews with our electrical engineers and argue for the right SoC, amount of flash/RAM, and combination of sensors, then prove those choices out on prototypes that reach real customers in months, not years.
  • Be the first person to make a new board do anything at all. Bring up new platforms and prototypes from virgin silicon: configure I/O, get SPI, I2C, UART, BLE talking, debug system init, validate the design, and turn unproven hardware into a product.
  • Own the layers everything else depends on. Peripheral drivers, secure bootloaders, device firmware updates, as well as the core management layers like power and connectivity, that determine whether a device in the field quietly recovers on its own or becomes an RMA.
  • Chase every microamp. Design protocols and hardware management for battery-powered sensors and gateways where the gap between good firmware and great firmware is measured in years of device life.
  • Work with the people who ship the whole product. Partner with product, full-stack, mobile and quality engineers so the data your firmware produces arrives intact and useful as it lands in the hands of dispatchers, fleet managers, and technicians who depend on it every shift.
  • Raise the bar for the engineers around you. At the Senior level, you are a force multiplier for your team. Through thoughtful designs, rigorous reviews, hands-on mentorship, and sound technical judgment, you help other engineers deliver better work. You lead by example, strengthen engineering practices, and connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. You bring clarity to ambiguous problems, act with intellectual honesty and urgency, and deliver high-quality solutions iteratively.

What you bring

  • 8+ years building firmware for resource-constrained systems, You have delivered reliable firmware where memory, processing power, energy and timing are all scarce, and you know how to measure, optimize and make deliberate trade-offs between them.
  • You have led firmware development for several new products end to end. You have taken firmware from initial concept through architecture, technical implementation, validation, and product launch, providing hands-on technical leadership throughout.
  • Substantial bare-metal and RTOS experience - Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or equivalent. You have made scheduling, memory and timing decisions. Mutexes and semaphores are everyday tools for you.
  • You have brought up new boards. First power-on of unproven hardware, at the bench with the electrical engineer who drew it up, working out whether the bug is in your code, a library, the schematic, or the part itself.
  • Fluency in the low-level interfaces - SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, ADC and the ability to debug the seam between hardware and software.
  • Real bench instincts. The usage of an oscilloscope, network analyzer, or RF spectrum analyzer, is how you form a hypothesis, not what you reach for after the print statements run out.
  • Senior-level scope. You have led work spanning hardware, firmware, cloud and quality from concept to shipped product. You have consistently driven consensus across teams.
  • Cross-layer judgment. You can trace how a decision at the driver level surfaces in a customer's experience three layers up, and you make that trade-off on purpose.
  • Fluency in C. You know what the compiler is doing, and you can read a linker map, a stack trace, or a corrupted heap without guessing.
  • You write things down. Design docs, review comments and post-mortems that other engineers can actually act on.
  • You ship fast without shipping badly. Comfortable iterating on customer feedback at speed, backed by automated testing and code you would be content to inherit.
  • You use AI smartly. It’s part of your every day work flow and multiplies your output without watering things down.

What will set you apart

  • BLE at depth - You understand what’s going on down the PHY and can build orchestration for the system to use in a performant and power efficient way.
  • Cellular IoT - LTE-M or NB-IoT modem integration, power state management, and the certification gauntlet (FCC, PTCRB, carrier approval).
  • Securing embedded systems end to end - secure boot, firmware signing, cryptography, and key management that survives contact with manufacturing.
  • OTA and device firmware update at fleet scale - A/B partitions, rollback, and the discipline of never bricking a device you cannot physically reach.
  • You’ve been on the factory floor - You have an understanding of the processes behind the mass production and quality assurance of electronics. You have a track record of fixing production show stoppers.

Role Summary

This role owns new product adoption as a company metric across Samsara's post-sale organization. It exists to proactively integrate every new product into post-sale processes — reviewing adoption data, developing and executing strategies to close adoption gaps, and reading out results — by driving action across the cross-functional teams that already touch post-sale customers today: Scaled Implementation & Success, Enterprise Implementation & Success, Customer Education, Partnerships, and Lifecycle Marketing.

This is an individual-contributor role built for someone who can execute directly, not just delegate. The person in this seat needs to personally drive work forward — running analysis, building plans, and closing gaps themselves — in addition to coordinating action across teams that don't report into this role.


Key Responsibilities

Integrate new products into post-sale processes

  • Proactively build the process for embedding every new product into existing post-sale workflows as it ships — sponsorship, enablement, and defined success metrics — so no new product launches into a vacuum.
  • Partner with Product/R&D early in the launch cycle so adoption is designed for up front, not addressed after the fact.

Diagnose and close adoption gaps

  • Review adoption data on an ongoing basis to identify where, and why, customers aren't adopting new products.
  • Develop strategies to close identified adoption gaps, and personally execute against those strategies rather than only assigning them to others.
  • Run a standing cross-functional cadence with Scaled Implementation & Success, Enterprise Implementation & Success, Customer Education, Partnerships, and Lifecycle Marketing to turn adoption data into agreed, tracked action.

Drive execution across teams without direct authority

  • Influence and coordinate action across the five post-sale teams above, none of which report into this role, using shared data, a standing cadence, and escalation through the VP of Customer Success when needed.
  • Build and maintain relationships with leaders across each function to keep adoption a shared, prioritized outcome rather than a side project.


What Success Looks Like

  • Every new product has a defined post-sale adoption plan in place at or before general availability.
  • Adoption metrics exist, are trusted, and are reviewed on a standing cadence.
  • Adoption gaps are identified and closed measurably faster than today's reactive baseline.
  • Cross-functional teams treat adoption as a shared, prioritized outcome rather than an unowned byproduct.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in an internal-facing role (Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Program/Project Management, or similar), with a proven track record of driving results on cross-functional initiatives without formal authority over the teams involved.
  • Strong understanding of post-sale, customer-facing functions (implementation, customer success, customer education, or similar) — this role needs someone who has sat close to, or within, these motions before.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and execute personally. This is not a pure coordination or delegation role; the person needs to be comfortable doing the work themselves, not just assigning it to others.
  • Comfort operating with data — able to define metrics, build or work with dashboards, and use adoption data to prioritize and justify action.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to read out results and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience at Samsara, or in a similarly matrixed, fast-moving organization, is a plus.

  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
  • Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem. 
  • Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
  • Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
  • Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
  • Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a dynamic, high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to mid-sized customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $20k to $100k, and involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs. 

This role is open for candidates residing in the following US states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah. The role requires travel approximately 25% of the time.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 2+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Experience independently closing new deals larger than $10,000 in annual revenue
  • All candidates must be located in one of the following states: Washington, Oregon, California, Alaska, Hawaii, Nevada, Idaho, Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, New Mexico, Arizona, Utah

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the midmarket space - medium to large deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary$152,000—$190,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

  • Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product.
  • Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time.
  • Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows.
  • Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently.

  • Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way.
  • Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth.
  • Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners.

Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential.
